ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)

   B. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   D. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
